title: Starlink Launch — February 2022
description: SpaceX launched 49 Starlink satellites into a 'minor' geomagnetic storm. Atmospheric drag increased dramatically, and 38 of the 49 satellites were lost. A lesson in taking even modest space weather seriously.
historicalOutcome: SpaceX launched despite the CME watch. 38 of 49 Starlink satellites never reached operational orbit due to increased atmospheric drag at 210 km. Estimated loss: $50–100 million.
